title: Minority children at risk from ETS.
ehr_evidence: The teams measured four different biomarkers in the blood cells of 109 Hispanic and African-American children, ages 1 to 6.
summary: Study evaluating the association between environmental tobacco smoke (ETS) exposure and cancer-related biomarkers in young minority children.
key_findings: The four measured biomarkers increased with ETS exposure in all exposure groups.
population: 109 Hispanic and African-American children, ages 1 to 6
